menu.language.restart_msg: The language setting has been saved. Restart the application to apply it.
compare.flag.checksum_mismatch: Checksum mismatch at the same version
compare.match.label.name: Name only (version differences are detected as changes)
compare.match.label.purl: purl only (version differences are detected as changes)
compare.match.hint.auto: Works even when the SBOMs were produced by different tools. A version bump is reported as a “version change”.
compare.match.hint.spdxid: For SBOMs made by the same tool and procedure (e.g. before and after editing). Different tools use different ID schemes, so nothing will match.
compare.match.hint.name_version: Only packages with exactly the same name and version are treated as the same. A version bump appears as “removed + added”.
compare.match.hint.name: If several versions of the same name coexist in an SBOM, packages may be paired by inference.
compare.match.hint.purl: Packages without a purl are always reported as added / removed.
compare.matched.name: name
compare.note.ambiguous: Several packages shared the same matching key, so they were paired by version → SPDXID → order of appearance (this involves guesswork).
compare.warn.spdx_version: The SPDX versions differ ({a} / {b}). The differences may include ones caused by changes in field definitions.
compare.warn.ambiguous: {n} pair(s) were matched by inference because several packages shared the same matching key (see the note in each package's details).
compare.warn.no_spdxid: {n} package(s) have no SPDXID and cannot be matched.
compare.warn.no_purl: {n} package(s) have no purl and cannot be matched (they are shown as added / removed).
compare.warn.name_fallback: {n} pair(s) could not be matched by purl and were matched by name instead.
compare.warn.spdxid_mostly_unmatched: More than half of the packages have no matching SPDXID. If the SBOMs come from different tools, set the matching key to “Auto”.
compare.csv.name: Package name
compare.detail.checksum_mismatch: The checksums do not match although the version is the same. This may indicate a rebuild, redistribution or substitution; please verify.
compare.detail.no_diff: There are no differences in the compared fields.
compare.col.name: Package name
compare.ui.search_placeholder: Search (name, version, SPDXID; space-separated terms are ANDed)
compare.ui.change_options_tip: Change the matching key or the compared fields and compare again
compare.ui.swap_tip: Swap the base (old) and the target (new) and compare again
compare.ui.export_csv_tip: Exports the differences to CSV. Unchanged rows are included when the current tab is “All” or “Unchanged”.
compare.ui.jump_tip: Selects the current package in the main window's tree (double-click also works)
compare.ui.select_hint: Select a package in the list on the left to see its details.
compare.ui.jump_missing: This package is not in the tree of the SBOM open in the main window.
